decisions.statement: A message is let go only where a transcript has the injection itself.
A message shown to be lost is given up on rather than waited on.
A message whose seat is mid-turn is waited on however long that takes.
A message nothing can be told about is given up on after a few looks.
A message given up on stays claimed rather than being offered again.
The transcript the seat has now is read as well as the transcript that seat held then.
A transcript that cannot be read is passed over rather than counted as silence.

definition: a message held claimed until the seat's transcript shows the seat was shown it
